17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 4936 North Lincoln Avenue #1S, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: | B2-3 Neighborhood Shopping District
Lot Area: 6,250 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing convert the existing ground floor retail unit
within the existing mixed-use building into a business live/work unit. When
complete, the resulting building will contain two (2) business live/work
units at grade and six (6) dwelling units above. No changes are proposed to
the height or footprint of the existing building. The subject property is a
Transit Served Location and will continue to be supported by six (6) off-
street parking spaces. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-
EE of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase
the off-street parking requirement for a Transit Served Location from 50%
(four (4) parking spaces) to 75% (six (6) parking spaces) and is seeking all
relief necessary, as allowed by the code, for the attached Type 1 Plan Set.

(A) — The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 18,750 square feet (0.56 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 781.25 square feet per D.U.
(6 residential units and 2
live/work units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 6 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (CTA Brown Line
Western station).

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: zero (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:
Northwest Side: 2 feet-6 inches (existing)
Southeast Side: 2 feet-6 inches (existing)
c. Rear Setback: 39 feet (existing)

() Building Height: 54 feet (existing)
